name: components-backgrounds-hexagon
blurb: Tessellating hexagons that lighten on hover.
description: Renders a responsive grid of clip-path hexagons that fills the viewport. Each hexagon lightens on hover with a smooth transition.
use_when: A geometric background that needs subtle interaction to draw attention to hovered areas.
avoid_when: When the viewport is very small or performance is critical — the grid recalculates on resize and may be heavy on mobile.
a11y: Passive background wrapper; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. No prefers-reduced-motion guard on hover effects.
